RuntimeWrapperWebpackPlugin.summary.en: RuntimeWrapperWebpackPlugin adds runtime wrappers to JavaScript and allow to be loaded by Lynx.
RuntimeWrapperWebpackPlugin.summary.text: RuntimeWrapperWebpackPlugin 为 JavaScript 添加运行时包装，使其能够被 Lynx 加载。

RuntimeWrapperWebpackPlugin.defaultOptio.en: `defaultOptions` is the default options that the [`RuntimeWrapperWebpackPlugin`](api:RuntimeWrapperWebpackPlugin) uses.
RuntimeWrapperWebpackPlugin.defaultOptio.text: `defaultOptions` 是 [`RuntimeWrapperWebpackPlugin`](api:RuntimeWrapperWebpackPlugin) 使用的默认选项。

RuntimeWrapperWebpackPlugin.apply.summar.en: The entry point of a webpack plugin.

RuntimeWrapperWebpackPluginOptions.banne.en: There are two types of banners: script(for app-service) and bundle(for js-render). You can decide to use which banner by the filename.
RuntimeWrapperWebpackPluginOptions.banne.text: banner 有两种类型：script（用于 app-service）和 bundle（用于 js-render）。可以根据文件名决定使用哪种 banner。

RuntimeWrapperWebpackPluginOptions.injec.en: The variables to be injected into the chunk.
RuntimeWrapperWebpackPluginOptions.injec.text: 要注入到 chunk 中的变量。

RuntimeWrapperWebpackPluginOptions.test..en: Include all modules that pass test assertion.
RuntimeWrapperWebpackPluginOptions.test..text: 包含所有通过 test 断言的模块。
